summary: Implementation plan for upgrading ReadWise AI with real-time webcam iris/gaze tracking, live speech-to-text forced word alignment, a calibrated 17-feature two-stage hybrid screening engine (1D-CNN+BiLSTM gaze sequence encoder + ETDD70-calibrated Gradient Boosted Ensemble), interactive gaze heatmaps and saccade trajectory plots, and dual Tree SHAP + LIME explainable AI.
